explanation: Merge of two UI changes. From main: the router runs one navigation attempt at a time with its own history write policy; a new shell control that moves the explorer calls supersede() before navigate, and a value a view reports back starts an attempt only when it changes. appRouter.ts gains supersede and a verified openInExplorer(id, track), and App.tsx routes its track, tab, contrast, leave-Compare and send-genes controls through it. From this branch: the shared evidence label and panel show an author follow-up, the tracker filters on it and the library searches it; no routing code is touched.
